The feed was designed to meet specific antenna requirements for a paraboloidal reflector.
The feed consists of a 3.5-turn helix wrapped around a 1/4-in diameter center conductor.
The helix is supported by a bead in rigid coax and a shorting stub.
The feed has a 20 percent bandwidth at L-band.
The feed has a peak power capability of 200 kW unpressurized.
The feed has a right-hand circular polarization.
The center conductor has a diameter of 1/4 in.
The helix has a diameter of 2.83 in.
The helix has a pitch of 1.9 in.
The helix is made of 1/4-in hollow tubing.
The bead in rigid coax supports the helix and center conductor.
The shorting stub shorts the helix to the center conductor.
The balun is a half-wave coax to two-wire (unequal diameters).
The two-stage transformer matches the 50-ohm coax to the helix.
The frequency range of the feed is not specified.
The feed was fabricated and assembled, except for the shorting stub.
